+
+## Execution addendum — Fusion, 2026-10-18
+
+Task `threetched-consolidation-fusion-20261018` / OD-121; source HEAD observed
+`051a20d056afba074e21d797aa34f8947c543c5a`. This addendum does not rewrite the
+original prompt or turn its historical deployment evidence into a new receipt.
+
+### Implemented source slice
+
+- Preserved the existing removal of `tched_plugins` and `tched_skills`, their
+  module/registry and bridge dispatch integration. No compatibility aliases.
+- Deleted `state_plugins/binary_namespace.rs`, its module declaration, router
+  schema attachment and early dispatch. Retired router `get`, `init`, `list`,
+  `patch`, `set`; retained the distinct typed `config_*` operations.
+- `state_plugins/threetched.rs::prepare_command` now refuses `skills.edit` and
+  editor-requesting `skills.add` before spawning. The executor has neither an
+  interactive terminal nor a captured content-input contract. Native capture
+  remains unchanged; refusal is an execution limitation, not successful editing.
+- Host mount adapter selects `threetched,tched_router`. Workspace population
+  points both extension/skill links at guest `plugins/threetched`; guest mount
+  root remains `/run/mount/3tchedfs`. Matching workspace and release guidance
+  describes dotted operations, changed result envelopes and exact grants.
+- No UI source/pinned-input change: scouts found no wrapper or short router-name
+  production caller in sibling UI. Typed configuration, Chat, route binding and
+  committed-state consumers remain unchanged. No native HTTP/WS contract was
+  invented to replace them.
+
+### All 18 wrapper dispositions
+
+Notation: `A(x,y)` means `"arguments":[x,y]`; `F(k,x)` means `"--k":[x]`.
+Absent/null optional old fields become omitted flags. Switches are booleans.
+Every native target below belongs to `threetched`; these are argument mappings,
+not automatic caller/grant migrations.
+
+| Retired wrapper | Native target / disposition | Argument correspondence |
+|---|---|---|
+| `tched_plugins.install_plugin` | `plugin.install` | `A(source)`, optional `F(registry,registry)` |
+| `tched_plugins.list_plugins` | `plugin.list` | `{}` |
+| `tched_plugins.migrate_plugins` | `plugin.migrate` | `{}` |
+| `tched_plugins.plugin_info` | `plugin.info` | `A(name)` |
+| `tched_plugins.remove_plugin` | `plugin.remove` | `A(name)` |
+| `tched_plugins.search_plugins` | `plugin.search` | `A(query)`, optional `F(registry,registry)` |
+| `tched_skills.add_bundle` | `skills.bundle.add` | `A(alias)`, optional `F(directory,directory)` |
+| `tched_skills.add_skill` | `skills.add` | `A(name)`, required `F(description,description)`; optional author/bundle/category/license/version flags; `--no-scaffold` boolean; no `--edit` |
+| `tched_skills.audit_skill` | `skills.audit` | `A(source)` |
+| `tched_skills.edit_skill` | Retired contents API; no equivalent captured operation | Do not drop contents or map to interactive `skills.edit` |
+| `tched_skills.install_skill` | `skills.install` | `A(source)`; optional agent/bundle/skill flags; `"--no-tier-banner":true` preserves old fixed option |
+| `tched_skills.list_bundles` | `skills.bundle.list` | `{}` |
+| `tched_skills.list_skills` | `skills.list` | Optional agent/bundle flags |
+| `tched_skills.remove_bundle` | `skills.bundle.remove` | `A(name)`, `"--yes":true` |
+| `tched_skills.remove_skill` | `skills.remove` | `A(name)`, optional agent/bundle flags |
+| `tched_skills.rename_bundle` | `skills.bundle.rename` | `A(from,to)` |
+| `tched_skills.show_bundle` | `skills.bundle.show` | `A(name)` |
+| `tched_skills.test_skills` | `skills.test` | Optional `A(name)`, `--verbose` boolean |
+
+Historical source was read with `git show HEAD:crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/{tched_skills,tched_plugins}.rs`, without restoring either file.
+It proves `install_skill` always supplied `--no-tier-banner` and `remove_bundle`
+always supplied `--yes`. This supersedes the scout's earlier default-output
+recommendation. Old editing piped bounded contents through `EDITOR=/usr/bin/tee`;
+that is absent from the canonical native contract and is not reintroduced.
+Old wrappers imposed narrower name/path/text validation; the native CLI accepts
+its own declared token schema and options. Native results are
+`{stdout,stderr,exit}`, not `{text}`. Nonzero exit follows the error path;
+preserve stderr warnings and uncertain/cancelled outcome receipts. Native bundle
+removal without `--yes` can exit zero without removing anything.
+
+Old capability groups were `cap.software.tched-plugins.{read,write,install,search}@v1`
+and `cap.software.tched-skills.{read,write,install,execute}@v1`.
+The exact new requirement for each native target `m` is the existing declaration
+`cap.software.threetched.call.c<lowercase SHA256 of exact UTF-8 m>@v1`.
+This formula is the current `command_policy`, not a new policy or grant writer;
+callers discover the actual sealed capability. There are no old-capability OR
+alternatives. Old read/idempotent methods become native mutation/non-idempotent
+declarations; broader CLI options also prevent authority-equivalence claims.
+No grant or identity was changed to mask this breaking cutover.
+
+### All 43 router dispositions
+
+Each named method below has an explicit disposition. Retained methods are not
+claimed consolidated merely because they call the same binary.
+
+| Methods | Disposition / dependency |
+|---|---|
+| `get`, `init`, `list`, `set`, `patch` | Retired in this slice. Native `config.get/init` use `A("model_routes")`; `config.list` uses `F(filter,"model_routes")`; `config.set` uses `A("model_routes",serialized_value)`. Native `config.patch` takes a file; old inline-operations convenience is retired, not losslessly mapped to stdin. |
+| `GetConfig`, `GetMcpConfig` | Retain masked/coherently published typed observations; defer native HTTP contract cutover. MCP's narrow grant must not become whole-config access. |
+| `GetConfigSchema` | Retain in this slice; independently actionable next removal. Engine already describes it as retired but schema/fallback remain; exact sealed `native_config` is the replacement authority. |
+| `PatchConfig` | Defer until MCP nested admission, narrow path restrictions and distinct capability reconcile with `config_patch`. |
+| `config_get`, `config_list` | Retain typed path/prefix reads and masking, including UI consumers; CLI stdout is not their result contract. |
+| `config_init`, `config_migrate` | Retain typed native configuration receipts/readback and SHM publication; no data/Cozo migration implied. |
+| `config_patch`, `config_set` | Retain atomic UI patch and catalog-model resolution/readback; defer native typed contract capture. |
+| `GetState` | Keep local committed whole-state projection, durable assignments and caller-filtered jobs. |
+| `GetProviderCatalog` | Retain in this slice; next bounded removal candidate in favor of `ListProviders`, with backing assertion migration. |
+| `GetModelRoutes` | Retain observed native model routes plus local integration until native typed capture. |
+| `GetRouter`, `GetStructuredOutput`, `ListUiSurfaces` | Keep local committed descriptors; production producers are not proven by fixture-seeded tests. |
+| `GetTools` | Defer typed native `/api/tools` capture, including param_domains and caller visibility/publication. |
+| `ListModels`, `ListProviders` | Retain typed filtering/observation consumers; defer native contract cutover. Preserve local assignments during publication. |
+| `SetModel`, `SetProvider`, `SetSelection` | Retain coherent selection validation/readback/SHM commits; atomic selection is not two CLI writes. |
+| `SetCozoRetrievalModel`, `SetObfuscationModel`, `SetOvsRoutingModel`, `SetQdrantRetrievalModel`, `SetVectorizationModel` | Keep durable local role assignments/CAS and catalog validation. No native-memory substitution or global chat selection. |
+| `ResolveRoute` | Keep local observed route resolver/ambiguity rejection; outer gemma_brain.route facade remains a separate candidate. |
+| `apply_catalog_model_binding`, `resolve_catalog_model_binding` | Keep catalog revision/availability, ordinary-profile, endpoint and caller-bound validation/readback required by UI. |
+| `get_own_agent_route` | Keep verified persisted caller-mode integration; no caller-selected identity/config. |
+| `Chat` | Keep local conversation/mode/context/episode orchestration; defer underlying native frame-contract derivation. Native agent CLI is not a stateless substitute. |
+| `start_generation`, `cancel_generation`, `get_generation_job`, `get_generation_jobs`, `delete_generation_job`, `recover_generation_jobs` | Keep private durable jobs, revision checks, queued-before-launch commit, cancellation ownership, terminal deletion and explicit recovery. |
+
+Source evidence: `tched_config_dispatch.rs`, `tched_config_engine.rs`,
+`tched_router_legacy_dispatch.rs`, `generation_jobs_dispatch.rs`,
+`generation_admission.rs`, `tched_router_generation.rs` and existing
+`mutation_engine.rs` admission/publication paths. Sibling consumers remain in
+`src/chat/{door-chat-adapter,native-routing,control-plane-model,router-committed-route}.ts`.
+
+### Remaining overlap and release obligations
+
+- Eight `large_language_model` outer facades remain removal candidates; do not
+  move redundant router methods there. Preserve generation-origin pins and
+  shared observed-state helper when that slice is selected.
+- MCP get_config/configure_server need outer+nested grant and path-policy
+  reconciliation. configure_tool_groups remains local projection policy.
+- Nine cron operations retain typed native readback and publication receipts
+  pending derived HTTP contracts; cron is currently install-global, not a
+  caller-private scheduler with ongoing initiator-grant rechecks.
+- Application `config` is a durable arbitrary-key owner, not native Config.
+  model_registry filtering and cognitive local integrations remain distinct.
+  OD-122 persona/config and OD-123 Cozo-native-memory work stay deferred.
+- Bridge generated contracts regenerate through its existing build script.
+  Checked-in FUSE specialization is historical generation1494 evidence; it
+  must be regenerated from the new isolated catalog through typed_specialize,
+  never mechanically renamed while retaining old hashes.
+- Expected delta against observed generation74 is two plugin removals,
+  `tched_plugins` and `tched_skills`, and five fewer router methods (43→38).
+  With no unrelated schema changes, arithmetic is 74→72 plugins and
+  1,388→1,365 methods. This is not an actual catalog receipt.
+
+Mounted metadata/schema reads succeeded at generation74, catalog hash
+`8a34d0da9517b137063314e07f5fa9a24fe3a3fe33920b1de2df941380041fd6`.
+Directory enumeration of the native plugin returned EIO; direct declared schema
